Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

I reviewed this head locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `61a817bed26bf42bf285638d5db337980bea6d0b`. No GitHub runner ran.

What looks good:

- The thinning step keeps the window ends and selects existing curve samples. The added error bound fits the callers' tolerance budget.
- All five new spacing tests pass. Both reported mutations fail as expected.
- I checked all four changed NC goldens line by line. All 516 removed lines are feed blocks on straight, monotone Z moves. The X words and feed rates stay the same across each removed run. No other command changes.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **failed**. It completed all 641 steps in 59.6 minutes. One suite failed. The other 640 steps passed.
- Builds with `--no-run`: passed for the selected post, motion, and app targets.
- CL: 3 tests passed.
- Post: 407 tests passed across 38 suites.
- Motion: 511 tests passed; 10 ignored. This includes the library (487), `turning_bore` (11), `turning_offset_spacing` (5), and `turning_prof` (8).
- App: 3,973 tests passed; 2 failed; 48 ignored across 595 suites.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The failed suite is `example_catalog` (3 passed, 2 failed):

```text
every_catalog_case_opens_regenerates_verifies_and_posts_byte_for_byte
crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:198:9
assertion `left == right` failed: turning/cone-thread: regenerated NC differs

every_catalog_case_rebuilds_from_camscript
crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:257:9
assertion `left == right` failed: turning/cone-thread: build.camscript NC differs from committed .nc
```

**Extra suites run**

The fixture search found the changed NC consumers. All ran in the quick gate, including `lathe_post` (7 passed), `lathe_post_inch` (6 passed), and `lathe_post_tormach` (8 passed). The other selected lathe-post suites passed too. All 595 app suites and the 38 selected post suites ran, so the fixture readers were not omitted. The diff changes no importer or STEP fixture. The extra kernel importer suites do not apply.

**Mutations**

I compiled temporary copies of the offset module with the PR's exact new test file. A small harness supplied the error enum. No worktree source changed.

- Original offset routine: red. The OD, ID, and window-end spacing tests fail. The OD gap is `4.440892098500626e-16`; the ID gap is `1.1102230246251565e-16`.
- Tail give-way disabled: red. The window-end test fails with a gap of `1.0000000005838672e-7`.
- PR routine before and after the mutations: green, all 5 tests. The Cargo suite also passes all 5 tests.

**Requested before merge**

1. `examples/catalog/turning/cone-thread/cone-thread.nc:70` — Refresh and review the catalog NC output for the new spacing rule. This example is on current upstream main. Its regeneration produces 732 lines against 1,197 committed lines: 465 `G01` lines are removed and none are added. Both catalog round-trip tests fail. Update the affected example artifacts as needed. Run `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` again. Correct the PR body's statement that this example is not on main.
2. `crates/motion/src/turning/offset.rs:137` / PR body, “Not exercised” — Run the full reached heavy gate on the final head. Current upstream AGENTS.md, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires this before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects 234 steps across motion and app. The body states that the full reach did not run. The reported 16-binary subset does not cover that reach. Record the reached lanes and their results in the body. I ran the plan only; these heavy results remain unverified.

The PR merges cleanly, but these two items block `merge-ready`. No UI files change, so screenshots are not required. The PR stays a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: both findings of the review on `bb0725ba8`. The new head is `575a1a8a7e19f40206d33458d97385b883bb4fc1`.

1. **Catalog NC for `turning/cone-thread`.**
   - The branch merges `upstream/main` at `97a880c53` (a clean merge).
   - Commit `575a1a8a7` rebuilds the case with `cargo xtask catalog --case turning/cone-thread`.
   - `cone-thread.nc` goes from 1197 lines to 732 lines. 465 `G01` lines are removed and 0 lines are added. The runs of same-X `G01` blocks go from 509 to 82.
   - The case README drops the #2882 limit line. The taper blocks and the thread blocks that the README names stay the same.
   - Pin: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` gives 19 passed. This includes `catalog_turning_cone_thread::regenerates` and `catalog_turning_cone_thread::rebuilds`.
   - Mutation: with the old `.nc` back, these 2 tests are red. With the new `.nc` back, they are green.
   - The PR body no longer says that the example is not on main.
2. **Full heavy reach on the final head.**
   - `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` ran all 233 steps in 86.0 min.
   - motion heavy: 34 lanes green (2 are known fails of #1950, red as expected).
   - app heavy: 196 of 197 lanes green (6 are known fails of #1950, #2845 and #2849, red as expected).
   - app heavy `pocket3d_hsm` is red: `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` gives (3158, 3130, 1141).
   - This failure is on `main` too and is tracked as #3050. I did an A/B check: with the `offset.rs` of `upstream/main`, the test gives the same (3158, 3130, 1141). No 3D pocket code calls the changed turning functions.
   - The PR body names the lanes and their results.

Gate on `575a1a8a7`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, 643 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

The PR stays a draft. Please review it again.

Please fix ASAP.

This PR has the label `needs-rework`. The open items are in the latest review comment on this PR. Push a fix, or say that you keep this PR. The maintainer asked for this reminder.

Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

The local trial merge with upstream/main at `704f35cf0ea51452ff426c52f067b6d518b8d8b9` succeeded. No GitHub runner ran.

What looks good:

- The cone-thread artifact fix passes both catalog tests. The earlier cone-thread finding is resolved.
- All five spacing tests pass. The thinning step keeps existing curve samples and both window ends.
- I checked all five changed NC files line by line: 981 feed blocks are removed and none are added. The four lathe goldens retain the same straight paths. The catalog changes keep the command types and feed rates. Their maximum deviation in radius/Z coordinates is about 0.003 mm.
- The project rebuild changes operation stamps and two cached move lists. It keeps the operation parameters and model data.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: failed. It completed 647 steps in 38.8 minutes. 646 steps passed; `app suites: example_catalog` failed.
- The selected post, motion, and app builds with `--no-run` passed.
- CL: 3 passed.
- Post: 418 passed across 39 suites.
- Motion: 511 passed; 11 ignored across four suites. This includes all five new spacing tests.
- App: 4,019 passed; 2 failed; 47 ignored across 600 suites.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The failed tests are:

```text
catalog_turning_contour_finishes::regenerates
crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:204
turning/contour-finishes: regenerated NC differs

catalog_turning_contour_finishes::rebuilds
crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:270
turning/contour-finishes: build.camscript NC differs from committed .nc
```

**Extra suites run**

The fixture search found the changed NC readers. I also ran these suites by name in a separate local command:

- `lathe_post`: 7 passed.
- `lathe_post_inch`: 6 passed.
- `lathe_post_tormach`: 8 passed.
- `example_catalog`: 28 passed; the same 2 tests failed.

All 600 selected app suites ran in the quick gate, including the other shared fixture readers. The PR changes no importer or STEP fixture. The extra kernel importer suites do not apply. No UI files change.

**Mutations**

I ran temporary Cargo harnesses outside the repository with the exact new test file. A small harness supplied the error enum. No repository source changed.

- Old offset routine: red. The OD, ID, and window-end spacing tests fail. The OD gap is `4.440892098500626e-16`; the ID gap is `1.1102230246251565e-16`.
- Tail give-way disabled: red. The window-end test fails with a gap of `1.0000000005838672e-7`.
- PR routine before and after these mutations: green, all 5 tests.

**Heavy lanes**

The PR body now records the full author run on this head: 233 steps, with 34 motion lanes and 197 app lanes. The known failures of #1950, #2845, and #2849 had their expected results. One ordinary heavy test remains red: `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, with counts `(3158, 3130, 1141)`.

The author reports an A/B check with the main offset routine. Issue #3050 also records the same Linux failure on main. I did not repeat the full heavy run or run the light lane after the quick failure. These are not local pass results from this review.

**Requested before merge**

1. `examples/catalog/turning/contour-finishes/contour-finishes.nc:12` — Refresh and review this catalog case for the new spacing rule. It is on current upstream main. Both regeneration paths produce 246 NC lines against 620 committed lines. Most changes remove short feed blocks. Some approach and retract X values also change from `20.762` to `20.76`. Rebuild the affected artifacts with `cargo xtask catalog --case turning/contour-finishes`. Run `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` and the quick gate again.
2. `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144` / PR body, full heavy results — Obtain a green full reached heavy run before readiness. Current upstream AGENTS.md, “Heavy lanes at review”, says that a reached heavy test must pass before readiness. The full run is now documented, but this test is still red. Use the reviewed fix for #3050, then rerun the full reached heavy gate on the final head. Record its lanes and results in the body.

The PR merges cleanly. These items block `merge-ready`, so it stays a draft with `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: both findings of the latest review on `575a1a8a7e19f40206d33458d97385b883bb4fc1`.

The new head is `a8dc06bd903d41af16461ebb15e7827a747f3b4a`.

1. Rebuilt `turning/contour-finishes` with `cargo xtask catalog --case turning/contour-finishes`.
   The NC file goes from 620 to 246 lines. The parameters, model, machine, and setup stay the same.
   Pins: `catalog_turning_contour_finishes::regenerates` and `catalog_turning_contour_finishes::rebuilds`.
   Mutation: the old NC file makes both pins fail. The refreshed NC file makes both pass.
   The full `example_catalog` suite gives 33 passed, 0 failed, and 2 ignored.
2. Merged `upstream/main` at `fc32feb0e`, which includes the reviewed fix for #3050 from PR #3078.
   Pin: `the_linux_x86_64_bore_count_pin_is_exact`.
   Mutation: the old Linux helper counts make the pin fail. The restored helper makes it pass.
   Full reached heavy run: green, 234 steps, 0 failed, 41.3 min. All reached lanes ran, with no omissions.
   The 234 steps include one release build and 233 test lanes. All gate steps are green.
   Motion lanes: 37 lanes; 57 ordinary tests pass. Two known-fail lanes for #1950 are red as expected.
   App lanes: 196 lanes; 43 ordinary tests pass. Four known-fail lanes are red as expected: one for #1950 and three for #2849.
   `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` passes, including `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`.
   The PR body records the final results.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, 655 steps, 0 failed, 37.4 min.
Clippy on motion and app: green, exit 0, 38.1 s (`--all-targets -- -D warnings`).

The PR stays a draft. Please review it again.
